issues: This historical chapter on purported death order is not evidence that natal charts forecast lifespan, mortality, physical danger or medical illness.
No patient-level, birth-certificate, mortality registry or preregistered time-to-event studies are available; mortality and spouse-abuse forecasts are prohibited.
The initial source says spouse significators in cadent houses ESPECIALLY second house, even though second is not cadent; preserve exact original anomaly.
A poor seventh ruler can allegedly signal either wife death OR prolonged illness, two non-equivalent outcomes and post-hoc flexibility.
Moon conjoined exactly ONE companion uses relative strength comparison in opposite branches; without reliable astronomical dignity grading no direction can be determined.
Moon separated from Mars AND applying Venus in Occidental part is one compound rule; wife count and death order are different outcomes.
Moon Venus conjunct Saturn in seventh combines spouse death and difficulty marrying; neither is an independently verified forecast.
Venus fourth with Mars and Saturn harsh aspects is separate from further Venus movable-sign qualification that adds multiple wives and all dying first.
Moon seventh in malefic ill aspects includes explicit Jupiter OR Venus beneficial support exception, not a universal Moon-seventh fatality prediction.
Venus occidental of Sun plus peregrine plus malefic conjunction OR hard square/opposition carries no objective definition of short lifespan.
Venus conjunct Mars twelfth is used for morally charged husband misconduct, NOT to predict wife death; no actual abuse classification.
Peregrine malefics with dominion in seventh is a possible historical internal dignity conflict; expert text/source review needed.
Lilly sometimes shifts targets from one wife to multiple wives or alleged enemies, further weakening falsifiability.
The next printed CXXXVII on Women's Marriage starts middle PDF634; not part of first-death chapter.
Selective original-source paraphrase only; original page-anchored photos do not validate human forecasts or constitute full diplomatic transcription.
